_what_this_is: Every command this repo's validation gate runs. ci.py and appproc.py are the ladder + driver (never edited per-repo, verbatim from the build-dark-factory skill); this file is the only thing that changes when the stack changes. Every command here must match .archon/workflows/dark-factory-validate-pr.yaml's harness invocation - one definition of a green build, not two.
_bootstrap_state: app/ is a local symlink to the real Unreal project (scripts/link-unreal-project.sh), not repo content - see .factory/decisions.md D-003/D-004 and CLAUDE.md's Environment section for why. driver=cli with smoke_args=--check-exe-only is a deliberately fast, launch-free check (appproc.py's CliApp hardcodes a 60s timeout on the smoke step with no way to configure it, and a real Editor boot does not reliably fit that window - verified empirically). The real Automation Framework run happens in harness/e2e.py instead, via app.run() with its own generous timeout. `static`/`unit` stay empty (honest SKIPPED, not a fabricated pass) until there is at least one real KrowdKontrol.Unit.* test - once one exists, set unit to: harness/run_ue_automation.sh KrowdKontrol.Unit. (unit_count_pattern above already matches its output). See harness/README.md and harness/run_ue_automation.sh.
